brief.text: Group 1 Automotive (GPI) recorded the single largest transaction on the dashboard at $23,669,114 from a 10% owner, narrowly surpassing GameStop’s (GME) $21,605,932 cluster total across three insiders. Pharmaceutical preparations emerged as a shared industry focus, with Cybin (CYBN) at $4,941,950 and Relmada Therapeutics (RLMD) at $1,671,990 both drawing multiple independent buyers. Meanwhile, Angel Studios (ANGX) stood out by appearing in both categories, generating a $5,384,452 cluster total from three insiders alongside a standalone $2,536,403 purchase from director Steven I. Sarowitz.
